title: Romantic Getaway to Kolkata: A Couple's Guide for 2026
metaDescription: Plan the perfect romantic trip to Kolkata. Sunset spots, intimate dining, and unforgettable experiences for couples in love.
excerpt: Kolkata sets the stage for romance like nowhere else. From sunset views to intimate dinners, this guide will help you plan the perfect couple's getaway.

content:
Few places in the world can match the allure of Kolkata. Whether you are planning a romantic getaway to Kolkata for the first time or returning for more, there is always something new to discover.

## Most Romantic Spots

- Sunset viewpoints that offer breathtaking panoramas over Kolkata
- Secluded beaches and hidden coves perfect for private moments
- Candlelit restaurants serving the finest local cuisine
- Scenic walks through charming neighborhoods and historic streets

![Romantic Kolkata](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1558431382-27e303142255?fm=webp&w=1200&q=60)

## Romantic Activities

Cooking classes for two let you learn the secrets of India's cuisine while bonding over delicious food.

## Where to Stay

Luxury resorts with private pools and ocean views create the ultimate romantic atmosphere in Kolkata.
